import json, random, subprocess, sys, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen

def run(prog, data):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3', prog], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout

def mutate(rng, doc):
    d = copy.deepcopy(doc)
    kind = rng.randrange(16)
    if kind == 0:   # remove a root key
        k = rng.choice(list(d)); del d[k]
    elif kind == 1: # add extra root key
        d["extra"] = 1
    elif kind == 2: # version wrong
        d["version"] = rng.choice([0,2,"1",1.0,True,None])
    elif kind == 3: # config key remove/add
        keys = list(d["config"])
        if rng.random()<0.5: del d["config"][rng.choice(keys)]
        else: d["config"]["zzz"]=1
    elif kind == 4: # model key remove/add
        keys = list(d["model"])
        if rng.random()<0.5: del d["model"][rng.choice(keys)]
        else: d["model"]["zzz"]=1
    elif kind == 5: # out of range int in config
        c=d["config"]; k=rng.choice(["slots","window","lanes","bucket_capacity","rate_num","pending_capacity"])
        c[k] = rng.choice([-1,0,257,10**9,1.5,"3",True,None,[],{}])
    elif kind == 6: # model shape break
        m=d["model"]
        if rng.random()<0.5: m["length_embedding"] = m["length_embedding"][:15]
        else: m["length_embedding"][0] = m["length_embedding"][0]+[0]
    elif kind == 7: # kernel > window
        d["model"]["kernel"] = min(5, d["config"]["window"]+1)
    elif kind == 8: # duplicate connection id
        if d["connections"]:
            d["connections"].append(copy.deepcopy(d["connections"][0]))
    elif kind == 9: # unknown connection in packet
        if d["packets"]: d["packets"][0]["connection"] = "nosuch"
        else: d["packets"]=[{"time":0,"connection":"nosuch","length":0,"draw":0}]
    elif kind == 10: # decreasing times
        if len(d["packets"])>=2:
            d["packets"][-1]["time"] = d["packets"][0]["time"]
            # ensure strictly less
            d["packets"][-1]["time"] = max(0, d["packets"][0]["time"]-1)
    elif kind == 11: # bad id
        if d["connections"]:
            d["connections"][0]["id"] = rng.choice(["","a"*33,"bad id","Ã©x","a b", 5, None])
    elif kind == 12: # bad split
        if d["connections"]: d["connections"][0]["split"] = rng.choice(["test","",None,5])
    elif kind == 13: # bad label/slot
        if d["connections"]:
            c=d["connections"][0]; c[rng.choice(["label","slot"])] = rng.choice([-1,1000,"1",True,None])
    elif kind == 14: # packet field type
        if d["packets"]:
            p=d["packets"][0]; p[rng.choice(["time","length","draw"])]=rng.choice([-1,10**13,"5",True,None,1.5,65536])
    else: # too many / wrong array types
        if rng.random()<0.5: d["connections"] = {"a":1}
        else: d["packets"] = 5
    return d

def raw_mutate(rng, text):
    kinds = [
        lambda t: t.replace("{", "[", 1),
        lambda t: t.rstrip() + "trailing",
        lambda t: t.replace(":", ": ", 1) + "",
        lambda t: '{"version":1,',
        lambda t: t.replace('"version": 1', '"version": 1, "version": 1', 1),
        lambda t: t.replace('"version": 1', '"version": NaN', 1),
        lambda t: t.replace('"version": 1', '"version": Infinity', 1),
        lambda t: t.replace('"version": 1', '"version": 1e400', 1),
        lambda t: t.replace('"version": 1', '"version": 01', 1),
        lambda t: t.replace('"version": 1', '"version": +1', 1),
        lambda t: t.replace('"version": 1', "'version': 1", 1),
        lambda t: t[:len(t)//2],
        lambda t: "",
        lambda t: "   ",
        lambda t: t.replace('"draw"', '"draw", "draw"', 1),
        lambda t: t + "\n",
        lambda t: "  " + t + "  \n",
    ]
    return rng.choice(kinds)(text)

rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
bad = 0
N = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 60
for it in range(N):
    doc = gen.gen(random.Random(rng.randrange(10**9)), 1.0)
    text = json.dumps(doc)
    mode = rng.randrange(3)
    if mode == 0:
        doc2 = mutate(rng, doc)
        data = json.dumps(doc2).encode()
        expect_invalid = True
    elif mode == 1:
        data = raw_mutate(rng, text).encode()
        expect_invalid = None
    else:
        data = text.encode()
        expect_invalid = False
    rc, out = run('/workspace/submission/main.py', data)
    rc2, out2 = run('/workspace/tmp/ref.py', data)
    if out != out2 or rc != 0 or rc2 != 0:
        bad += 1
        print("MISMATCH iter", it, "mode", mode)
        print("  main:", rc, out[:200])
        print("  ref :", rc2, out2[:200])
        if bad > 5: break
print("fuzz done, mismatches:", bad)
PYEOF
